description: This file contains integration tests for the 'Create Catalog Item' API endpoint in a web application, verifying authorization and successful creation of catalog items.

classes.name: CreateCatalogItemEndpointTest
classes.description: Test class for the API endpoint responsible for creating catalog items, including authorization checks and validation.

methods.name: ReturnsNotAuthorizedGivenNormalUserToken
methods.description: Tests that a normal user token receives a 403 Forbidden response when attempting to create a catalog item.

methods.name: ReturnsSuccessGivenValidNewItemAndAdminUserToken
methods.description: Verifies that an admin user can successfully create a catalog item and receive the correct response content.

methods.name: GetValidNewItemJson
methods.description: Prepares and serializes a valid JSON payload for creating a new catalog item.
